title: Millions Hit the Road and Skies as Labor Day Weekend 2026 Travel Rush Begins
snippet: As the final holiday weekend of summer kicks off, millions of Americans are packing airports and highways for Labor Day 2026. Here is what you need to know to navigate the rush.
content:
The final unofficial weekend of summer is officially underway, with millions of Americans gassing up their vehicles, checking into airport terminals, and hitting the road for Labor Day 2026.

Record Crowds Expected at Airports

Transportation officials are bracing for a massive surge in travel volume through early next week. The Transportation Security Administration expects passenger checkpoints to remain packed, projecting near-record screenings through Tuesday. Travelers are strongly advised to arrive at airport terminals at least two hours early for domestic flights and three hours early for international departures.

Navigating the Highway Congestion

For drivers, AAA predicts heavy gridlock, particularly around major metropolitan areas and popular coastal destinations. Traffic analysts warn that Friday afternoon and Monday evening will see the heaviest delays. Transportation experts recommend leaving before sunrise or late in the evening to bypass the worst peak commute hours.

Tips for a Hassle-Free Holiday Trip

Whether traveling by air or highway, preparation is key. Drivers should double-check vehicle tire pressure and fluid levels before embarking on long journeys, while air travelers should utilize mobile boarding passes and check flight statuses frequently for real-time updates.
